items.title: Ashley Keating and Allan Whitworth Interview, 1963-03-22
items.q: I don't think she knew who Lawrence Mariro was. And who is Lawrence Mariro to you? Uh, well, he still is everything I want to be as far as a musician goes. Uh, I can't recall ever hearing a more thrilling, uh, sound on the banjo.

ctx.x: Did she have a clue about what you were trying to do?

Uh, she half understood, I think. She, she knew I wanted to play chords and wasn't particularly interested in becoming a virtuoso. But, uh, I don't think she knew who Lawrence Mariro was. And who is Lawrence Mariro to you? Uh, well, he still is everything I want to be as far as a musician goes. Uh, I can't recall ever hearing a more thrilling, uh, sound on the banjo.
I think we could use a little more volume there maybe, huh? Well, uh, did you, uh, play for fun with any groups or did you...?
